result: Implemented exposure-comparison protocol v2. Candidate fingerprinting is explicitly a coarse reduced-composition + site-count SHA256 bucket and cannot authorize exact membership. Authoritative exact and near-duplicate verdicts use frozen pymatgen StructureMatcher configurations. Prototype grouping is bound to Matbench Discovery commit 26d3a19073df8cb303c7e4849a0d65e74746d9eb and moyopy 0.3.4; because the upstream 1.3.1 wheel omits required Wyckoff data, execution is source-bound to the exact checkout and verifies prototype.py plus both reference files by Git blob SHA. Production indexing and exposure-audit claims remain closed.
